newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan seeks Jan-Feb leaded and unleaded reformate.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan seeks Jan-Feb leaded and unleaded reformate.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has announced a tender to buy 250,000 barrels each of leaded and unleaded 95-octane reformate for delivery late January to February, a company official said on Monday.
The tender which closes December 30 and is valid for two days, seeks the leaded cargo for delivery Janauary 28-February 3 and the unleaded for February 11-28.
Both cargoes are for delivery to Keelung or Taichung.

CPC last week bought one 250,000-barrel unleaded cargo for delivery January 18-27 at $26.20 per barrel from a European major and another from a Dutch trader for February 11-20 delivery at $25.75 per barrel, both on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
